# Compatibility environment for macOS arm64 and Python 3.11.
#
# The upstream requirements.txt is a Linux/CUDA environment freeze.  It includes
# NVIDIA and Triton packages that are not installable on macOS, so this file keeps
# only the direct runtime, plotting, tuning, and test dependencies used by the two
# vendored repositories.

# Numerical stack kept below the NumPy/Pandas API removals used by pymgrid 1.4.1.
numpy==1.23.5
pandas==1.5.3
scipy==1.10.1
scikit-learn==1.2.2
statsmodels==0.13.5

# Forecasting and online-learning stack.
torch==2.0.0
pytorch-lightning==1.5.10
torchmetrics==0.11.4
tensorboard==2.12.0

# Differentiable convex optimization stack.
cvxpy==1.3.0
cvxpylayers==0.1.5
# Upstream's older solver pins do not publish Python 3.11 arm64 wheels.
# These releases keep the same solver APIs while providing native wheels.
diffcp==1.0.21
ecos==2.0.14
osqp==0.6.7.post3
scs==3.2.4.post3

# python-microgrid runtime dependencies.
gym==0.26.2
cufflinks==0.17.3
plotly==5.13.1
PyYAML==6.0
tqdm==4.65.0

# ol-ems plotting and experiment utilities.
matplotlib==3.7.1
SciencePlots==2.0.1
tikzplotlib==0.10.1
webcolors==1.12
syne-tune==0.4.1

# Keep old Lightning/TensorBoard consumers away from incompatible future APIs.
fsspec==2023.3.0
packaging==23.0
protobuf==3.20.3

# Tests.
pytest==7.2.2
